title: Input Date Tile
description: A date picker input. Compiles to AC 1.6 Input.Date.

id.description: Unique input id - the key under which the value is submitted to the host.

label.description: Human-readable label rendered above the input.

value.description: Initial date value in YYYY-MM-DD format.

min.description: Inclusive lower date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

max.description: Inclusive upper date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.
